2700.translation: A: Fewer households dey make kimchi themselves. Kimchi-making culture dey disappear? B: Household number alone no enough to judge. Even if people buy am, if dem still share with neighbours and check on each other, culture still continue. C: But if gathering to work together disappear, that sharing no fit stop too? B: That concern get sense. Na why our institute focus on recording and supporting gathering and sharing, no be only kimchi taste.

2701.translation: A: Foreigners fit find am strange say work start later and aircraft movement even adjust for exam day. B: I understand am as social promise to protect exam fairness. Na effort to make everybody write under same conditions. C: But that care no dey increase candidates pressure? B: E fit. But removing care go create unequal conditions. To reduce pressure, I think we should fix system wey get only one exam chance, instead of only reducing the care.

2702.translation: A: Some areas don create system wey people exchange work and count am by hours. We fit call am modern pumasi? B: I think say e continue the spirit. For both, relationship dey repay effort instead of money. C: But when e grow, recording and managing hours go cost more and efficiency fit fall? B: Na valid point. So I think this system fit small village wey people know each other best. Expanding am to whole city no reasonable. Still, its value na relationships, no be only efficiency.
